ValidationRule.description: This rule makes sure the Phone Number field follows a prescribed format.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c) && $Setup.ER_Validation_Rules_Settings__c.VRBE02_Valid_Phone__c = false && ISPICKVAL(ER_Country_Code__c, 'BE') && NOT(ISBLANK(Phone)) && NOT(REGEX( Phone ,"(^$)|^[+]?([0-9]*[/\\.\\s\\-\\(\\)]|[0-9]+){3,24}$"))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill in a valid phone number
